FICTIONAL TEST REPORT
RADIOGRAPH LEFT WRIST, TWO VIEWS
Date of examination: 19/02/2025
Clinical details: Fall onto outstretched hand, pain and swelling over the distal radius.
FINDINGS:
There is a transverse fracture of the distal left radial metaphysis, approximately 2 cm proximal to the radiocarpal joint. The distal fragment is angulated dorsally by 15 degrees and is displaced dorsally by 4 mm. There is no intra-articular extension. The ulnar styloid is intact and the distal radioulnar joint is congruent. Radial height is maintained at 11 mm. The carpal bones are normally aligned and no scaphoid fracture is identified, though a dedicated scaphoid series may be obtained if clinical concern persists. There is soft tissue swelling over the dorsum of the wrist.
IMPRESSION:
1. Extra-articular dorsally angulated fracture of the left distal radius (Colles type).
